2607.02502.title: DemoPSD: Disagreement-Modulated Policy Self-Distillation
2607.02502.paper_summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a practical method for training large language models (LLMs) to reason, where a single model acts as both the teacher and the student with different levels of information access. However, recent studies have found that the teacher's dense token-level supervision, conditioned on privileged information, can lead to overfitting to in-domain patterns, suppress exploration, and hurt cross-domain generalization, while also introducing a more fundamental issue: *privileged information leakage*, where the student encodes answer-dependent shortcuts that are unavailable at test time. We introduce **DemoPSD**, a novel framework that resolves such problems through the idea of *selective adoption of teacher guidance*. Instead of fitting the full teacher distribution, DemoPSD steers the student toward a *reverse-KL barycenter target*, a weighted geometric combination of the teacher and student distributions, that naturally balances learning from the teacher with preserving the student's own reasoning capacity. We measure the difference between their distributions and use such a discrepancy to adaptively control the blending at each token position. We provably show that DemoPSD achieves **(1)** *leakage attenuation*, i.e., effective mitigation of privileged information leakage; and **(2)** *exploration preservation*, i.e., preservation of exploration capacity under dense token-level distillation. Extensive experiments on SciKnowEval across four scientific fields show that DemoPSD outperforms both GRPO and SDPO while maintaining higher training entropy and robustly generalizing to out-of-distribution GPQA benchmarks.
2607.02502.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自蒸餾（OPSD）已成為訓練大型語言模型（LLMs）以進行推理的實用方法，其中單一模型同時擔任教師和學生，並具有不同層次的信息訪問。然而，最近的研究發現，教師的密集令牌級監督，依賴於特權信息，可能導致對內部模式的過擬合，抑制探索，並損害跨域泛化，同時還引入了一個更根本的問題：*特權信息洩漏*，即學生編碼了在測試時無法獲得的依賴於答案的捷徑。我們介紹**DemoPSD**，一個通過*選擇性採納教師指導*的理念來解決這些問題的新框架。DemoPSD不是擬合完整的教師分佈，而是將學生引導到*反KL重心目標*，這是一種教師和學生分佈的加權幾何組合，自然平衡了從教師學習與保留學生自身推理能力之間的關係。我們測量它們分佈之間的差異，並利用這種差異在每個令牌位置自適應地控制混合。我們可證明DemoPSD實現了**(1)** *洩漏減少*，即有效減輕特權信息洩漏；以及**(2)** *探索保留*，即在密集令牌級蒸餾下保留探索能力。在四個科學領域的SciKnowEval上進行的廣泛實驗顯示，DemoPSD的表現優於GRPO和SDPO，同時保持更高的訓練熵並穩健地泛化到分佈外的GPQA基準。
